source: This is it... we're dead.
before: 这是... 我们死定了。
after: 完了……死定了。

source: Well, I'd say since %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% made this super-smart choice, %HESHE% %VERB_GETS_GET% to fight this one.
before: 嗯,我会说,从 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 做了这个超级聪明的选择, %HESHE%  %VERB_GETS_GET% 对抗这个。
after: 既然是%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%做了这么聪明的选择，那就由%HESHE% %VERB_GETS_GET%来打吧。

source: Good luck, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! You got this!
before: 祝你好运 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! 你办得到的!
after: 祝你好运 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! 你办得到的!

source: Nah, you don't.
before: 不,你没有。
after: 不，你办不到。

source: Look, Polly, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% is going for it!
before: 听着, 波莉, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% 准备上场了!
after: 波莉，快看，%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%出手了！

source: Whoa... I've never heard the sound of so many fist bones breaking at the same time before.
before: 珃... 我从来没有听到过如此多的拳骨同时被打碎的声音.
after: 哇……这辈子没听过，那么多块手骨同时碎掉的声音。

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, try hitting it with a bat!
before: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%试试用球棒打它!
after: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%试试用球棒打它!

source: Okay, new plan: try hitting it with two bats!
before: 来,新计划,用两只蝙蝠来打它
after: 好，新计划：两根球棒一起上！

source: Polly, look, %HESHE% %VERB_IS_ARE% getting devoured by the dinosaur. Do you think it's all part of a clever plan?
before: 波莉听着, %HESHE%  %VERB_IS_ARE% 被恐龙吞噬了 你觉得这都是聪明计划的一部分吗?
after: 波莉，你看，%HESHE% %VERB_IS_ARE%被恐龙吃了。你觉得，会不会是某个高明计划的一部分？

source: Maybe, Scott... maybe.
before: 也许吧 斯科特... 也许吧。
after: 也许吧 斯科特... 也许吧。

source: It's not.
before: 岂不是.
after: 不是。

source: When WTF-682 poops you out days later, you smell so bad they end up kicking you all out of the facility.
before: 几天后WTF -682把你拉出院时 你闻起来很臭 结果被他们踢出院门
after: 几天后，WTF-682 把你拉了出来。臭得实在受不了，他们干脆把你们全赶出了设施。

source: In a way, you succeeded... but not really. You lose -3 STAMINA from being eaten.
before: 从某种意义上说,你成功... 但不是真的,我说,我... 你从被吃中失去了 -3 Stamina。
after: 某种意义上，你成功了……也没真成功。被吃了一回，你失去了 -3 体力。
